title.narrative: Investing for impact against tuberculosis - Gabon (01-Jul-2022-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Gabon, Tuberculosis, Centre de Recherches Médicales de Lambaréné (CERMEL)This program has the following goals: D’ici 2024, contribuer à la réduction de la mortalité de 20% par rapport 2019 au Gabon, c’est à dire passer de 84 à 63 décès/100,000 habitants dues à la tuberculose / By 2024, contribute to a 20% reduction in mortality compared to 2019 in Gabon, i.e. from 84 to 63 deaths/100,000 inhabitants due to tuberculosis.. D’ici 2024, contribuer à une réduction 4% de l’incidence liée à la tuberculose au Gabon c'est-à-dire passer d’une incidence de 521 cas pour 100.000 habitants à 498 pour 100 000 / By 2024, contribute to reducing by 4% the incidence of tuberculosis in Gabon, i.e. from an incidence of 521 cases per 100,000 inhabitants to 498 per 100,000. The objectives of this program are: Augmenter le nombre notifié de cas de tuberculose nouveaux cas et rechutes de tuberculose de 4879 à 8075 en 2024 et avoir un succés thérapeutique pour 90% des cas mis sous traitement / Increase the reported number of tuberculosis cases, new cases and relapses tuberculosis from 4,879 to 8,075 in 2024 and achieve therapeutic success for 90% of cases put on treatment.. Augmenter de 103 en 2020 à 168 en 2024 le nombre de malades annuellement mis sous traitement pour une tuberculose multi-résistante ou résistante à la rifampicine et atteindre un taux de succès thérapeutique d'au moins 85 % à l’horizon 2024./ Increase from 103 in 2020 to 168 in 2024 the number of patients annually undergoing treatment for multi-resistant or rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis and achieve a therapeutic success rate of at least 85% by 2024.. Effectuer en 2024 le depistage VIH chez 80% des nouveaux cas et rechutes et mettre sous therapie préventive 95% des patients coinfectés TB VIH / In 2024, carry out HIV screening in 80% of new cases and relapses and put 95% of patients co-infected with TB HIV on preventive therapy. Augmenter la contribution communautaire avec en 2024 17% des cas de tuberculose toutes formes confondues orientées par la communauté / Increase the community contribution with 17% of tuberculosis cases of all forms in 2024, referred by the community

Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - community referrals

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Impact indicators targets and results for GAB-T-CERMELP03
Outcome indicators targets and results for GAB-T-CERMELP03

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
